wiki.title: Silverfist
wiki.text:
Silverfist is a dwarf enemy NPC that players fight in the Rumbledome, located in Sunstone Valley. He is a Skullz thug whose allegiance is with the Skullz. The Rumbledome announcer states that prior to the battle, Silverfist had been spent years sparring with the manguana hunters in the Sandscale Oasis.
